Name: Mace Strike
Description: A quick mace swing that strikes every enemy caught in the arc, knocking them back.

Name: Mace Slam
Description: Slam your mace into the ground, crushing all enemies near the impact — heavy knockback with a chance to slow survivors.

Name: Ground Slam
Description: Slam the ground, damaging and briefly stunning all enemies around you.

Name: Shield Bash
Description: Lunge forward and slam your shield into an enemy, knocking it far back with a high chance to momentarily stun it. Hold to charge: lunge further and hit harder. Heavier shields hit harder: +1 damage per 10 shield armor. Requires a shield equipped.

Name: Fire Bolt
Description: Launch a searing bolt of flame toward the cursor with a chance to set enemies ablaze.

Name: Arcane Burst
Description: Gather arcane power, then detonate it at the target location — the burst lands after a short charge-up.

Name: Ice Spike
Description: Launch a crystalline shard that pierces the cold into its target — chilling hits build up toward a deep freeze.

Name: Chain Lightning
Description: An instant bolt that leaps between nearby enemies. Electrocuted victims seize up under the current for seconds after.

Name: Summon Skeleton Archers
Description: Raise skeletal archers that follow you and pepper your enemies with arrows. Managed from this menu with + and - (each RESERVES part of your maximum mana while it exists); tap ` to rally them to a point, hold ` to call them back. Fallen archers rise again near you for free.

Name: Summon Skeleton Warriors
Description: Raise skeletal warriors that charge your enemies and cut them down at arm's reach. Managed from this menu with + and - (each RESERVES part of your maximum mana while it exists); tap ` to rally them to a point, hold ` to call them back. Fallen warriors rise again near you for free.
